protocol_metadata.about: f(x) Protocol is a DeFi protocol on Ethereum that splits yield-bearing collateral (stETH, weETH, ezETH, WBTC, CVX) into two components: fxUSD, a decentralized stablecoin capturing real yield, and xPOSITION, a leveraged long position with minimized liquidation risk via an on-chain rebalancing mechanism. Users can mint fxUSD by depositing collateral into Treasury/Market contract pairs, and earn yield by depositing fxUSD into stability pools. The protocol is governed by FXN token holders via veFXN voting escrow, with protocol revenue shared to veFXN holders, and is managed operationally by a community multisig with 9 named signers.
